name: Tarrasque
summary: A colossal monstrosity that bites, claws, and swallows foes, reflects spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The tarrasque has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.text: If the tarrasque is targeted by a *{ref:spell/magic-missile}* spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a **1–5,** the tarrasque is unaffected. On a **6,** the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=20}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition and can't teleport.

actions.name: Tail
actions.onHit: If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

actions.name: Thunderous Bellow

save.targets: each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone

actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/deafened} and {ref:condition/frightened} conditions until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Swallow

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time)

bonusActions.onFailure: The target is swallowed, and the {ref:condition/grappled} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/restrained} conditions and can't teleport, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes {dmg:16d6:acid} at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a {dc=20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {ref:condition/prone}.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the tarrasque can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The tarrasque regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Onslaught
items.text: The tarrasque moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed}, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

items.name: World-Shaking Movement
items.text: The tarrasque moves up to its {ref:glossary/speed}. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose {ref:glossary/concentration} and, if Medium or smaller, have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
